title: A randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled, multicenter, phase II/III efficacy and safety study of oral TherO2-01S22 as add-on therapy on top of first line anti-HER2 targeted treatment of patients with Metastatic Breast Cancer TherO2-01S22 in HER2-positive breast cancer: TherO2-MBC Study
official: A randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled, multicenter, phase II/III efficacy and safety study of oral TherO2-01S22 as add-on therapy on top of first line anti-HER2 targeted treatment of patients with Metastatic Breast Cancer TherO2-01S22 in HER2-positive breast cancer: TherO2-MBC Study
summary: Main objective: (Phase III) To compare the effects of anti-HER2 targeted containing regimen with and without oral TherO2-01S22 in terms of Objective response rate (ORR).

interventions.name: VINORELBINE ARROW 10 mg/ml, solution à diluer pour perfusion
Trazimera 420 mg powder for concentrate for solution for infusion
Docetaxel Accord 160 mg/8 ml concentrate for solution for infusion
Perjeta 420 mg concentrate for solution for infusion
PACLITAXEL AHCL 6 mg/ml, solution à diluer pour perfusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Women or men aged more than or equal to 18 years old
2. Initial serum calcium and fasting blood glucose levels must be normal
3. Metastatic setting of a histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the breast
4. Overexpression of HER2 in the primary tumor or a metastatic lesion (3+ by ICH or 2+ with confirmation of positivity by FISH or SISH)
5. Performance status = 0, 1 or 2
6. Metastatic disease requiring the initiation of an anti HER2 containing regimen
7. First line treatment for metastatic disease
8. Patients for whom a minimum of 3-month life expectancy is anticipated
9. Baseline LVEF value > 50%, measured by cardiac MRI, by echocardiography (Simpson’s method) or by MUGA scan within 7 days before randomization. According to trastuzumab and pertuzumab Summary of Product Characteristics
10. Informed consent form signed
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients not eligible for anti-HER2 therapy
2. People with diabetes
3. Persons deprived of liberty by judicial or administrative decision
4. Persons not affiliated to a social security system or equivalent
5. Persons receiving psychiatric medical care
6. Persons subject to a legal protection measure (guardianship, curatorship, safeguard of justice)
7. Patients previously treated at the metastatic setting by systemic treatment
8. Serious cardiac illness or medical conditions disallowing administration of anti-HER2 therapy. According to trastuzumab and pertuzumab SPCs
9. Known hypersensitivity to trastuzumab, pertuzumab, TherO2-01S22, murine proteins or to any of the excipients
10. Spinal cord compression and/or symptomatic or progressive brain metastases (Brain metastasis are not acceptable unless asymptomatic or treated and stable off steroids for at least 30 days prior to start of study drug).
11. Patients who, for social, geographic or psychological reasons, cannot be adequately followed up and/or are incapable of undergoing regular controls
12. Pregnant or breastfeeding women
